CORPORATE LAW SERIES | BOARD RESOLUTIONS

How does a company formally approve important decisions?

In corporate governance, decisions are not merely discussions or informal agreements. They must be properly authorised, recorded, and documented through a structured legal process.

Our latest edition of the DraftKaari Corporate Law Series explores Board Resolutions and their significance under the Companies Act, 2013.

📚 In this edition, we cover:

🔹 Meaning and importance of Board Resolutions
🔹 Resolutions passed at Board Meetings
🔹 Matters requiring approval through Board Resolutions
🔹 Resolutions by Circulation
🔹 Practical takeaways for law students and aspiring legal professionals

We also highlight the relevance of Sections 173, 174, 175 and 179 of the Companies Act, 2013.

💡 Key Takeaway: Understanding corporate law is not just about knowing statutory provisions; it is about understanding how legal decisions are formally structured, approved, and implemented in practice.

At DraftKaari, we believe in learning law with purpose, drafting with clarity, and practising with discipline.

comment: The practical challenge often lies in the supporting documentation. A valid resolution is only part of the picture; quorum, proper notice, interest disclosures and accurate minutes matter equally during an audit or dispute.
